messages:
mika (release-manager): heads-up: canary for opt-quant-v3b on runtime 2.15 shows a sudden p99 token latency jump (~120ms -> ~260ms) starting 2026-03-19 09:12 UTC. noticed in region eu-west-1.
observability-bot: alert: model=opt-quant-v3b runtime=2.15 region=eu-west-1 metric=p99_token_latency previous=120ms current=260ms rate=+116%
ingrid (infra): thanks — rolling graphs look correlated with latest runtime kernels landing. can we isolate to quantized paths?
jason (runtime): prelim check: yes, regression surface seems limited to q4-kernel path used by opt-quant-v3b. other models not impacted. reproducer on staging queued.
mika (release-manager): proposal: temporarily pin opt-quant-v3b to runtime=2.14 in hosted and dedicated pools in eu-west-1 while we triage. keep the pin scoped to model variant only (no global runtime rollback). intent: 24h pin with automated unpin if not extended. any objections?
emma (sdk): quick note: SDK has a minor compatibility check for runtime-annotated routing, but pinning model->runtime mapping is transparent to clients. we should still mention in release notes to avoid confusion.
jason (runtime): agree. will prepare patch and suggested canary steps. main risk: new traffic split complexity for dedicated customers pinned by pool. ingrid can you confirm we can apply model-level pin without disturbing reserved pools?
ingrid (infra): yes, we have routing override for model->runtime mapping. will apply to hosted and dedicated edge in eu-west-1 only. no infra downtime expected.
mika (release-manager): action: deploy-bot command to create pin, set expire=24h. I'll trigger once we have a thumbs-up from deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: To create a pin, confirm command: `!pin scope=model model=opt-quant-v3b runtime=2.14 region=eu-west-1 expire=24h reason="p99-latency-regression" author=mika`
mika (release-manager): executing now.
deploy-bot: OK: pin created (pin_id=pin_20260319_euw_optq_v3b). Applied to hosted & dedicated routing tables in eu-west-1. Expires 24h after 2198765432 unless extended.
emma (sdk): added a quick note in the SDK CHANGELOG draft: "Runtime pinning: opt-quant-v3b pinned to runtime 2.14 in eu-west-1 due to latency regression; clients unaffected; expected auto-unpin in 24h unless extended."
jason (runtime): running staged canary tests against pinned mapping. test plan: synthetic long-seq and short-seq p99, kv-cache stress, and quant-kernel microbench.
imika (mika): small correction: test plan is jason's — ack.
jason (runtime): test results round 1: pinned mapping dropped p99 back to baseline (~125ms). reclaiming KV cache hit improved steady-state. still running longer runs.
ingrid (infra): alert: a few dedicated pools had routing hits to the pin, telemetry shows no increased error rate. good.
emma (sdk): flag for release notes: "If you operate private deployment with runtime lockstep upgrades, check runtime compatibility for quantized kernels; contact support if you see unexpected p99 increases"
mika (release-manager): decision: keep pin for the 24h window, run full regression tests, target a runtime hotfix (2.15.1) if root cause confirmed in q-kernel. schedule: triage today, hotfix tomorrow morning UTC if reproducible.
jason (runtime): started bisection on the kernel commit range. will post PR link once we have candidate.
emma (sdk): small ops ask — can we add a telemetry flag to the SDK so users can opt-into verbose kernel metrics? good to correlate client-side.
ingrid (infra): created internal incident ticket: INC-2026-0319-optq-p99 with assignees jason, ingrid. link: https://redwood.internal/INC-2026-0319 (internal).
mika (release-manager): follow-ups: 1) jason triages and posts blamelist/PR by EOD UTC, 2) ingrid applies pin scope chart to avoid expanding to other regions, 3) emma updates SDK CHANGELOG and docs, 4) i'll update the public status page if we decide to extend beyond 24h.
jason (runtime): initial candidate commit: kernel/attention-q/commit@f3a9b2 appears correlated. building 2.15.1 with revert for testing.
deploy-bot: note: pin pin_20260319_euw_optq_v3b currently active. To extend: `!extend pin_20260319_euw_optq_v3b hours=24 author=mika`. To unpin early: `!unpin pin_20260319_euw_optq_v3b author=mika`
mika (release-manager): thanks all. will reconvene once jason has test results. tagging this thread for postmortem if hotfix required. :white_check_mark:
